Name: Watering Can Tweaks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By default, this mod simply changes charged watering to fill adjacent tilled tiles instead of a predefined rectangle:

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10947/10947-1644103620-858775311.gif[/img]


It also has config variables for the following:

[list]
[*]"ChargedStaminaMult": 1.0, - multiply the stamina used for the adjacent filling by this amount (set it to < 1 for less stamina use).
[*]"VolumeMult": 1.0, - multiply watering can capacity by this amount.
[*]"WaterMult": 1.0, - multiply number of adjacent tiles watered by this amount.
[*]"FillAdjacent": true - water adjacent tiles while charging the watering can by holding the tool use button.
[/list]

It also works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11411]Connected Garden Pots[/url]﻿ to let you water multiple adjacent garden pots at once.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
